AboutWindow/Description: A Dink Smallwood DMOD manager application for launching, installing or packing DMODs
AboutWindow/ResourceCredits: Resources and open source projects used in this application:
AboutWindow/Package/DinkNetwork/Descript: Dink's home for the last couple of decades! The place to visit to get DMODs or learn to make them.
AboutWindow/Package/DinkGraphics/Descrip: The application makes use of Dink Smallwood graphics for some of the images.
AboutWindow/Package/Icons8/Description: Some of the icons used within the application are sourced from icons8.com
AboutWindow/Package/AvaloniaUI/Descripti: The GUI framework powering this application! It's pretty awesome!
AboutWindow/Package/Citrus.Avalonia/Desc: A cool theme for AvaloniaUI. Martridge uses a custom fork of the original Citrus theme bringing many improvements, among which the live theme palette swapping and custom theme palettes.
AboutWindow/Package/SevenZipExtractor/De: A wrapper for the 7zip library dll. Used in the Windows version of the application for the Dink Installer.
AboutWindow/Package/SharpCompress/Descri: A C# implementation of various compression algorithms. The version used here is modified to have faster BZIP2 compression/decompression!
AboutWindow/Package/Bzip2/Description: A C# implementation of BZIP2 compression. A modified version of this is used in the modified version of SharpCompress.
AboutWindow/Package/NewtonsoftJson/Descr: JSON Serialization. Used for the configuration files.
AboutWindow/Package/GetText/Description: C# implementation of gettext. Used for parsing FreeDink localization files.
AboutWindow/Package/HtmlAgilityPack/Desc: HTML parser - used to parse data from The Dink Network in the online DMOD browser
AboutWindow/Package/Ignore/Description: C# implementation of a .gitignore parser. Used to parse .dmodignore files.
AboutWindow/Package/UtfUnknown/Descripti: C# implementation of Mozilla Universal Charset Detector and uchardet.
AboutWindow/Hotkeys/KeyF2: F2 - Toggle between DMOD browser and Online DMOD Browser (if enabled)
AboutWindow/Hotkeys/KeyF6: F6 - DMOD Packer page (if DMOD Developer features are enabled)
AboutWindow/Hotkeys/KeyEsc: ESC - cancels some operations / returns to DMOD Browser on some pages
AboutWindow/Hotkeys/KeyPlayDmod: CTRL+D - in the DMOD browser, launches selected DMOD using currently selected game engine
AboutWindow/Hotkeys/KeyEditDmod: CTRL+E - in the DMOD browser, launches the currently selected editor for the currently selected DMOD
